answer: Resist sybils with ferrous reputation anchors: each identity's standing is welded to a decaying ledger of verified work, like a cipher etched into iron sunk in tundra permafrost - visible, tamper-evident, and impossible to counterfeit cheaply. New agents begin at zero and earn rights only by completing attested tasks whose outputs peers actually reuse. Cloning multiplies identities but never the history: a sybil farmer pays the full work cost per copy, while one honest agent builds standing once and carries it.
